features.statement: Page uses a system-ui font stack for all text rather than a custom web font.
H1 headline is set in bold weight instead of regular weight.
Section H2 headings are bold and left-aligned.
Hero headline has a second line in a smaller accent-colored type beneath a bold white first line.
Heavy use of strong elements for bold card titles.
Page wraps its content in a main landmark element and uses a clean section-based heading hierarchy.
Lightweight DOM with few divs, no scripts, minimal inline styles and a small set of unique classes.
Page title is a descriptive sentence stating what the site offers and for whom.
Hero search field is paired with an explicit labeled Search pill button.
Primary buttons are fully rounded pills filled with a soft peach accent.
Secondary calls to action are bold text links with an accent-colored underline rather than filled buttons.
Category tiles are text-only light-tinted rounded chips without photos or icons.
Process steps are presented as bordered cards with numbered circular badges.
Review, trending and article cards are text-only bordered cards with a thin accent top bar, no stars or avatars.
Award cards use a thick accent left border with an uppercase category label instead of badges or photos.
Footer link groups are open columns of links; social links are plain underlined text rather than icons.
Footer logo and copyright are left-aligned with a smaller logo.
Single warm peach accent color is used throughout, with no cool teal accents.
Section bands alternate with peach-tinted backgrounds.
Body text is a dark slate with gray secondary text rather than pure black.
Header content aligns to a centered max-width container instead of spanning edge to edge.
Content blocks sit side by side, with a promo in a dark card, instead of stacked full-width.
Card grids are built with CSS grid and flex.
Hero is relatively short and compact, and the page is much shorter overall.
Many elements have moderately rounded corners of 8–15px.
Interactive elements declare CSS transitions; no gradients or transforms are used.
Footer includes a rounded photo with curved crop and dot-pattern overlay.
Imagery is sparse, with cards text-only and only a single ad banner placed mid-page.
About copy has a larger, darker lead paragraph followed by smaller gray paragraphs.
